spiritgiven.comments: We believe they deserve a 13 because of their impressive fair-mindedness throughout the game as well as keeping a high level of self control and an excellent attitude towards each other and us. Calls were brief and discussed respectfully.
There were several foul calls but all were resolved quickly and with fair-mindedness.

The game was very intense and competitive, but the physicality was led to a few plays considered dangerous by the game advisors. Slightly higher physicality was acceptable for both teams, but we want to ensure the game stays safe. However, even with all the stoppages and language barriers there was calm and patient communication between the teams.

We believe there were several calls made during this game on an unreasonable basis (travels, fouls, etc) which reflects poor fair mindedness. Some were contested and some were overruled by video. 
During this game there was also a disconnect between the coaches' decisions and the information distributes to the players in relation to covid protocols. This led to some frustration and conflict between players on the sidelines before it was resolved. This is not part of the scores, just a note.
There was very minimal body contact and plays were made safely. Communication was excellent even with a language barriers for many team members.
There was a lot of contact and foul calls made during this game. Even though the game was very intense, there should have been a stronger focus on maintaining less body contact.
This game had good communication, especially during foul calls. Spirit improved thoughout the game and was better than last game.

Double teams occured often and were not fixed after several discussions about it. Many foul and contact calls were made which resulted in long discussions where the unbiased (GA or video) decision was rarely accepted. The frequency of calls led to disrupted momentum of points. There were also several occurrences where they did not understand the rules which led to unnecessarily long discussions. We wish this final could have felt more spirited for how special of a game it should be.

spiritreceived.comments: Very lovely team both on and off the field, thank you for humility regardless of the score and we applaud you on how well you were able to adapt to the rule changes of wfdf :)
